text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! Let's cook up some
out-of-this-world
daikon radish!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've got my cooking wine, soy sauce, and
fried
fish cakes! ♪ And now for the main
event!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The dai...kon... Huh. Where's the
daikon?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...It's not here. I must've forgotten to buy one. Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute is pretty upset that she
wasn't able
to make her favorite daikon
radish dish.
